text: 因西藏日喀则市吉隆县遭受泥石流灾害，澳门特区政府决定通过澳门基金会向西藏自治区捐助三千万人民币，支持当地的救援及善后工作。同舟共济，血浓于水，一方有难，八方支援。除捐助外，澳门特区政府将尽力提供医疗救援等灾区所需的各项支援，积极支持相关善后工作。（大湾区之声）
text_en: Due to a mudslide disaster in Gyirong County, Shigatse, Tibet, the Macao SAR government has decided to donate 30 million RMB to the Tibet Autonomous Region through the Macao Foundation to support local rescue and recovery efforts. Standing together in solidarity, blood is thicker than water, and when one region is in trouble, all regions support. In addition to the donation, the Macao SAR government will make every effort to provide medical rescue and other disaster-zone support needed, actively assisting related recovery work. (Greater Bay Area Voice)
